guest.bio_context: Sally Field has had a career spanning more than 60 years, winning two Oscars and three Emmys, and has a separate Wikipedia page dedicated solely to her awards. She is known for roles ranging from Gidget to Mary Todd Lincoln, as well as The Flying Nun. She was nominated for an Emmy for her starring role in Remarkably Bright Creatures on Netflix.

pending_qa.q: What role does Sally Field say people are most surprisingly still talking about?
pending_qa.r: Sally Field says she is most surprised that people still bring up The Flying Nun, including young people in their teens and twenties. She noted it is always surprising because she has done so much other work throughout her career.

pending_qa.q: Why was filming The Flying Nun painful for Sally Field?
pending_qa.r: Sally Field explained that filming The Flying Nun was painful because it was still the 1960s and there were no special effects — she was suspended by wires coming out of her nun's habit. She was sometimes on a 50-foot crane and would be flown into the side of a building.

pending_qa.q: Was the octopus in Remarkably Bright Creatures real or CGI?
pending_qa.r: According to Sally Field, the octopus in Remarkably Bright Creatures was CGI, not a real animal. She noted it is hard to train an octopus for that kind of work, and the intimate scenes involving tentacles were all achieved through digital effects.

pending_qa.q: What is the name of Paula Poundstone's dog mentioned during the Wait Wait Don't Tell Me interview with Sally Field?
pending_qa.r: Paula Poundstone's dog is named Dashiell Hammett, named after the famous crime writer. She mentioned the dog kept barking at a squirrel during the interview, and noted that the dog responds to 'Dash' but not to the full name Dashiell Hammett.

pending_qa.q: What roles has Sally Field played that illustrate the range of her acting career?
pending_qa.r: Sally Field has played both Gidget and Mary Todd Lincoln, illustrating an extraordinary range across her 60-plus-year career. She also starred as a flying nun in The Flying Nun and most recently as a lead character opposite an octopus in Remarkably Bright Creatures on Netflix.
